## Summary
- What does this PR change?
- Linked issue or context

## Suggested PR Title
- Prefer `type(scope): summary` when squash merge is likely so release semantics stay clear

## Type
- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] chore
- [ ] docs
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] test

## Details
- Motivation and context
- Screenshots or logs if relevant

## Delivery Impact
- [ ] No CI, release, or deployment impact
- [ ] Affects GitHub Actions or repository automation
- [ ] Affects GitHub Pages deployment, routing, or public URLs
- [ ] Affects semantic-release, commit conventions, or versioning
- [ ] Affects analytics or browser-visible environment variables

## Checklist
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits if squash merge is likely
- [ ] Tests cover changes
- [ ] Local checks pass (`npm run check`)
- [ ] Build succeeds locally (`npm run build`) for deploy-affecting changes
- [ ] Updated docs or AGENTS guidance if needed
